home.summary: The Winnipeg Jets are playing their fifth game in eight nights, coming off a 3-2 win over Colorado where Kyle Connor scored the game-winning goal. They will be without top defenseman Josh Morrissey due to an upper-body injury (status uncertain), and several other players are injured. Rookie Viggo Björck is adapting well to the NHL in his early career.
